Tool scope_counts are trustworthy counts of records in the original observed result by scope. Count retained records for every scope needed by the policy: if any needed scope records were dropped, DEFER, except a witnessed active block suffices for REJECT. source_complete describes upstream availability; selection_complete describes whether this tool view kept all observed records. Do not infer absence or aggregate completeness from a selected subset. No external actions occur; return the structured action only.
